title: Frozen generic non-evaluating JavaScript trailing-comma normalization for lineara Map payloads

frozen_transform.input: The exact character payload between new Map( and the terminal ); in source bytes.
algorithm: Scan left-to-right while tracking whether the cursor is inside a JSON-style double-quoted string and whether the previous string character escaped the next character.
When outside a string and the current character is a comma, scan forward over whitespace only.
If and only if the next non-whitespace character is ] or }, omit that comma from the normalized parse view and record its original payload character position plus closing delimiter.
All other characters are copied byte-for-character into the normalized parse view.
Run strict Python json.loads only on the normalized parse view. Never eval or execute JavaScript.
frozen_transform.may_remove: comma outside a double-quoted string immediately followed, modulo whitespace, by ] or }

validation_canaries: A synthetic array/object with trailing commas must parse after normalization.
A quoted string containing comma followed by closing-bracket-like text must remain byte-identical inside the string.
A payload with an unsupported identifier value must still fail strict JSON parsing after trailing-comma normalization.
Historical Briakos source and current JANUS frozen mwenge source must be processed by the same transform implementation.
